timing_scope: max(worker end_ns) - min(worker start_ns), after a synchronized barrier; excludes spawn and result IPC
workload: Each worker performs K increments; total work is P*K (weak scaling)
synchronization: No global lock in shared counter increments; privatized variant locks once for final publication

variants.privatized: local Python int loop, one locked final write

metric_definitions.s_variant: T_variant(1) / T_variant(P), as requested by PDF; workload is not fixed
metric_definitions.e_variant: (1/s_variant - 1/P)/(1 - 1/P), PDF raw-time diagnostic, not a valid fixed-work serial fraction here
metric_definitions.work_normalized_speedup_variant: P * T_variant(1) / T_variant(P), assumes serial work scales linearly with P
metric_definitions.work_normalized_e_variant: Karp-Flatt applied to work-normalized speedup; diagnostic only, not a fitted serial fraction
metric_definitions.p1_e: undefined (blank in TSV, null in JSON)

limitations: macOS process scheduling and heterogeneous cores are uncontrolled; no portable CPU pinning used
Pure Python interpreter overhead can obscure coherence effects; a collapse or monotonic trend is not guaranteed
64-byte spacing can leave two counters sharing one 128-byte line on this host
A synthetic serial-time normalization P*T1 is not an independently measured serial P*K baseline
